title: Organizer repeats a completed tournament
description: From a completed event, Repeat opens the wizard with the same type and players so you can run it again or modify the field.

steps.title: Completed event
steps.body: Open a finished tournament. Repeat copies its setup; you can change the name and roster before creating.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.body: Repeat starts a new tournament with the same format and participants.

steps.title: Wizard prefilled
steps.body: You land in the create flow with the prior type and players. Adjust, then create — or back out if you only wanted to inspect.
steps.resultNote: Repeat opened the tournament wizard from the completed event.
